setup.U: S minus exceptional divisor E; equivalently X_reg via the resolution isomorphism
setup.carrier: hypothetical geometrically integral irreducible Gamma subset S of class V6 and normalization genus 1
setup.local_model: At p in Gamma cap U, S is smooth and Gamma is a Cartier divisor, hence the completed local curve germ is a reduced plane hypersurface singularity.
setup.delta_U_definition: delta_U=sum_p delta_p over singular p of Gamma in U

delta_definition.use: delta invariant as normalization-length invariant for reduced one-dimensional Nagata local rings

branch_lower_bound.statement: delta invariant >= number of geometric branches - 1
branch_lower_bound.use: bound local branch excess by local delta

exact_local_lemmas.singular_delta_positive: Every singular reduced plane-curve germ has integer delta_p >= 1.
exact_local_lemmas.branch_excess_bound: If r_p is the number of geometric branches, r_p-1 <= delta_p.
exact_local_lemmas.multibranch_detection: r_p>=2 implies delta_p>=1; a smooth-locus normalization noninjectivity point is therefore charged to delta_U.
exact_local_lemmas.unibranch_firewall: r_p=1 does not imply delta_p=0; cuspidal/unibranch singularities remain allowed.
exact_local_lemmas.node_example: An ordinary node has (delta_p,r_p)=(1,2); this shows the branch-excess bound is sharp.

global_numerical_envelope.interpretation: These counts enumerate only the coarse numerical pairs (delta_p,r_p) allowed by the branch lower bound for 1<=delta_p<=472; they do not classify or assert analytic realizability.

canonical_hyperplane_multiplicity_lemma.claim: For any set T of at most 6 distinct points of Gamma in U, sum_{p in T} mult_p(Gamma) <= 186.
proof_steps: Any at most 6 points in P^6 lie on a hyperplane H.

No canonical hyperplane section can contain Gamma as a component: if H|_S=Gamma+R with R effective and no Gamma component, then R.Gamma=K.Gamma-Gamma^2=186-758=-572, contradicting nonnegative intersection of distinct effective curves on smooth S.
Therefore H meets Gamma properly with total intersection K.Gamma=186.
At each selected smooth-ambient point p, local intersection I_p(H,Gamma) is at least mult_p(Gamma), so summing gives the claim.
canonical_hyperplane_multiplicity_lemma.scope: Independent multiplicity budget only; it is not converted to a delta upper bound without an additional theorem relating multiplicity and delta.

parameterized_residual_ledger.global_state: Choose delta_U in [0,472], a finite set of smooth-locus singular points p_1,...,p_s with s<=delta_U, positive integers delta_j summing to delta_U, and branch counts 1<=r_j<=delta_j+1.
parameterized_residual_ledger.additional_multiplicity_constraint: For every subset of at most 6 listed points, the corresponding curve multiplicities satisfy sum m_j<=186.
